requirements.title: CO_MIN argument restrictions and intents
requirements.definition: A is integer, real, or character with corresponding shape, type, and type parameter values and is not coindexed; RESULT_IMAGE, STAT, and ERRMSG have the stated scalar forms, intents, and corresponding-reference restrictions.

pending.A-integer-real-or-character: Source-control uses integer, real, and character declarations for A; invalid types are unnumbered argument restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.A-corresponding-same-shape-type-paramete: Source-control only across corresponding references; no executable oracle is claimed for CO_MIN argument correspondence in the single-image suite.
pending.A-not-coindexed: Source-control uses local noncoindexed A; coindexed actuals are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.A-intent-inout: Source-control records that A is INTENT(INOUT); no local singleton execution is used as an oracle for a CO_* intrinsic.
pending.RESULT_IMAGE-current-team-scalar-same-if: Source-control uses scalar RESULT_IMAGE=1 for a one-image current team form; multi-image mismatch or out-of-team values are unnumbered restrictions without diagnostic facets here.
pending.STAT-noncoindexed-integer-range-at-least: Source-control uses a noncoindexed default integer scalar STAT variable; STAT assignment semantics are owned by 16.6 and are not observed here.
pending.ERRMSG-noncoindexed-default-character-sc: Source-control uses a noncoindexed default character scalar ERRMSG variable; ERRMSG text is never compared.

requirements.title: CO_MIN computes scalar and elementwise minimum values
requirements.definition: For scalar A the computed value equals the minimum of A in all corresponding references; for array A each element equals the minimum of corresponding elements in all corresponding references.

pending.single-image-scalar-minimum-identity: OUT OF SCOPE: CO_MIN runtime behavior is a CO_* collective effect and this suite does not use single-image singleton execution as an oracle by user decision.
pending.single-image-array-minimum-identity: OUT OF SCOPE: CO_MIN elementwise runtime behavior is a CO_* collective effect and this suite does not use single-image singleton execution as an oracle by user decision.
pending.multi-image-minimum-out-of-scope: OUT OF SCOPE: comparing values from two or more images requires a multi-image collective run, while this suite's fixtures are single-image by user decision.

requirements.title: CO_MIN assigns the computed value on selected images and otherwise leaves A undefined
requirements.definition: The computed value is assigned to A if no error occurs and RESULT_IMAGE is absent or identifies the executing image; otherwise A becomes undefined.
